page.overview:
Who is Vauthry?

Vauthry is a non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV who serves as the secondary antagonist of Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers. He is the mayor of the city of Eulmore, letting his people live in luxury and bliss before the world comes to an end.

Believing himself the leader of the world by divine right, he seeks for what remains of the First to submit to his will and authority.

Following Minfilia Warde's preventing Norvrandt from being consumed in the Flood of Light, Emet-Selch enacted a contingency plan for the Eighth Umbral Calamity to occur. He appeared before the mayor of Eulmore, taking advantage of the man's desire to keep his position indefinitely by talking him into having his unborn son be infused with the essence of a Lightwarden. Due to his innate ability to render sin eaters docile, Vauthry was thus instilled with a god complex by his father as he eventually succeeded him as the ruler of Eulmore. In reality, Vauthry had murdered his parents in a fit of rage during a temper tantrum. Ascending as ruler, Vauthry gradually turned the city into a despotic realm where the poor serve the rich and privileged under the guise of a paradise offering sanctuary in a broken world. Aided by a sinister pair of female Jongleurs, Vauthry used his status to feed the citizens meol leftovers secretly made from sin eater flesh to extend his ability.

It is believed that when the Scions of the Seventh Dawn were being summoned by the Crystal Exarch, the Ascians (possibly Emet-Selch) convinced Vauthry to exhume the bodies of the Warriors of Light of the First and turn them into powerful sin eaters known as Cardinal Virtues, meant to serve as a defense mechanism against those who would attempt to reverse the Flood of Light.
